text: Mechanical Engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that studies the design, manufacture, operation, control and optimization of mechanical systems. It integrates knowledge from mechanics, materials science, electronic technology, computer science, etc., aiming to conduct theoretical analysis and engineering practice, Solve problems such as the design and development, production and manufacturing, and maintenance and management of mechanical equipment. Cultivate compound engineering and technical talents with the capabilities of mechanical design, manufacturing process, electromechanical control and project management.
